data.name: Fatme
data.gender_notes: Fatme is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fatme is an Arabic name that symbolizes abundance, wealth, and prosperity. It is also associated with Fatima, the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Fatme carries the meaning “Abundance, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatme usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fatme is a name that is deeply revered in Islamic tradition, as it is associated with Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
data.etymology: Fatme belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatme total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فاطمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل فطم، ويُعتبر من الأسماء المُقدسة في الإسلام، وهو اسم بنت النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ويعتبر هذا الاسم ذا意义 عميق في التراث الإسلامي والثقافة العربية

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.meaning: خواتین کا نام جو کھولنے یا دودھ پلانے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو فطم سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اسلام میں اسے مقدس نام سمجھا جاتا ہے، یہ نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی بیٹی کا نام ہے، اور اس نام کی گہری意义 ہے اسلامی روایات اور اردو زبان میں

in_hindi.meaning: महिलाओं का नाम जो खोलने या दूध पिलाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है
